cards.title: Design a PGO C Benchmark
cards.when: Use when a C function is suspected slow and you need a measured delta from a profile-guided release build.
cards.cmds:

env ./bench.profgen --iterations 100000 --out bench.profgen.txt
cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fprofile-use bench.c -o bench.profuse
env ./bench.profuse --iterations 100000 --out bench.profuse.txt
diff bench.profgen.txt bench.profuse.txt

env ./bench.o2 --iterations 100000 --out bench.o2.txt

cards.title: Design a Hot Loop Benchmark

diff hot.txt hot.new.txt

cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror after.c -o after

cards.cmds:
grep -r "int safe_copy" include/
grep -r "int safe_copy" include/ | wc -l
grep -r "int safe_copy" include/ | head -1

cards.title: Log diff output for C files
cards.when: When comparing two versions of a C file to capture changes in logic or declarations.
cards.cmds:
diff original.c modified.c
diff original.c modified.c | wc -l
diff original.c modified.c | head -10

cards.title: Log sanitizer errors from C binary
cards.when: When running a C binary built with AddressSanitizer to capture memory violation reports.
cards.cmds:
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -o /tmp/san_test test.c
env /tmp/san_test
test $? -ne 0

cards.title: Replace duplicated parse logic with helper
cards.when: The Python function has duplicated validation code and tests cover the public behavior.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest tests/test_parse_port.py -q
python -m pytest -q
python -m compileall -q app
git diff --stat -- app/parse.py tests/test_parse_port.py

cards.title: Extract repeated fetch call into helper
cards.when: A Python module repeats the same fetch or lookup in several functions.
cards.cmds:
rg "fetch_user" app
python -m pytest tests/test_users.py -q
python -m mypy app/users.py
git diff --stat -- app/users.py

cards.title: Raise specific ValueError for bad input
cards.when: Python code catches a broad exception and converts invalid input into a string.
cards.cmds:
rg "except Exception" app
python -m pytest tests/test_validate.py -q
python -m compileall -q app
git diff --unified=3 -- app/validate.py tests/test_validate.py

cards.title: Replace mutable default argument with None
cards.when: A Python function uses a mutable list or dict as a default argument.
cards.cmds:
rg "def " app/cache.py
python -m pytest tests/test_cache.py -q
python -m compileall -q app
git diff --unified=3 -- app/cache.py

cards.title: Draft a C decision memo skeleton
cards.when: Use when a new C choice must be documented before implementation.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p docs
touch docs/decision-memo-c.md

cards.title: Compare C build options in a table
cards.when: Use when choosing C standards, flags, or test tools for a C project.
cards.cmds:
rg -n CFLAGS
rg -n decision docs

cards.title: Verify C flags match the decision memo
cards.when: Use when a C decision memo claims a build flag and the code is ready for review.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/decision-memo-c.md
grep -n Werror Makefile
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -x c /dev/null -c -o /dev/null

cards.title: Record a C decision with sampo
cards.when: Use after a C decision has a chosen option, reason, and revisit trigger.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/decision-memo-c.md
sampo decide "C11 with -Wall -Wextra -Werror" --why "clean build" --rejected "C17" --revisit "2026-06-01"

cards.title: Design a release verification command sequence
cards.when: Use it when preparing a JavaScript or TypeScript package for release.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
npm ci
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .

cards.title: Design a TypeScript release typecheck gate
cards.when: Use it when a TypeScript release must fail before broken types ship.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint .

cards.title: Design a production incident capture for release
cards.when: Use it when a released change immediately harms users or shows a red signal.
cards.cmds:
sampo capture --incident 'checkout returns 500' --signal 'node --check src/index.js'
sampo capture --incident log 'rollback deploy' --expect 'error rate falls'
git status --short

cards.title: Design a release note and tag check
cards.when: Use it when a release candidate has passed checks and needs a clean tag.
cards.cmds:
git status --short
cat CHANGELOG.md
git tag v1.4.2
git log --oneline -5

cards.title: Inspect Python project before planning
cards.when: Use this card when a Python repository needs a plan and current facts must come from files.
cards.cmds:
cat pyproject.toml
find . -name 'test_*.py' -type f
pytest --collect-only -q
python -m pip check

cards.title: Map affected Python modules for a feature
cards.when: Use this card when a requested feature may touch more than one Python file.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'parse_port' .
find . -name '*.py' -type f
head -n 60 src/app/ports.py

cards.title: Plan a safe dependency change
cards.when: Use this card when a user asks to add or pin a Python dependency.
cards.cmds:
cat pyproject.toml
python -m pip show requests
python -m pip check

cards.title: Plan Python test-first behavior
cards.when: Use this card when a Python change needs tests before implementation.
cards.cmds:
find . -name 'test_*.py' -type f
grep -n 'test_parse_port' tests/test_ports.py
pytest --collect-only -q

cards.title: Plan public C API surface first
cards.when: Use before adding or changing a C function exposed to callers.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '^int ' src/*.c
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/copy.c
make test

cards.title: Plan JSON twin for C API
cards.when: Use when a C result is read by humans and scripts.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'json' src/*.c
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/cli.c
jq . tests/api_out.json
make test

cards.title: Plan error contract for C CLI
cards.when: Use when a C program returns failure and callers need to react.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'return -1' src/*.c
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/main.c
make test

cards.title: Plan backward compatible C API change
cards.when: Use when changing a public C function signature or behavior.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'copy_char' src/*.c
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only src/copy.c
make test

cards.title: Review Rust error handling in a diff
cards.when: Use when a Rust diff touches error paths or Result types.
cards.cmds:
git diff HEAD~1 -- '*.rs'
rg -n unwrap app/src
rg -n expect app/src
rg -n 'let _ =' app/src
rg -n panic app/src

cards.title: Review unsafe and raw pointer code
cards.when: Use when Rust code contains unsafe blocks, raw pointers, or FFI.
cards.cmds:
rg -n unsafe app/src
rg -n SAFETY app/src
rg -n deref app/src

cards.title: Review Rust UI state updates safely
cards.when: Use when reviewing Rust UI code that mutates state, widgets, or async tasks.
cards.cmds:
rg -n state app/src/ui
rg -n unwrap app/src/ui
rg -n spawn app/src/ui

cards.title: Validate Tailwind utility classes against CSS build
cards.when: Use when verifying that custom Tailwind classes exist in the generated stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
grep -c 'class-utility-name' /tmp/out.css
npx prettier --check .

cards.title: Audit deck slide titles for full-sentence claims
cards.when: Use when checking if Markdown slide titles are complete sentences as required.
cards.cmds:
grep -E '^#{1,2} ' deck.md
grep -c -E '^#{1,2} ' deck.md
head -5 deck.md

cards.title: Verify every number has source unit comparison
cards.when: Use when auditing a report to ensure all numeric data is fully contextualized.
cards.cmds:
grep -nE '[0-9]' report.md
grep -cE '[0-9]' report.md
sed -n '10p' report.md

cards.title: Prefer standard library before adding a dependency
cards.when: Use this card when a new feature could be covered by a built-in module or an existing lockfile entry.
cards.cmds:
rg "Buffer" src
node -p "require('node:util').Buffer !== undefined"
grep -n "left-pad" package-lock.json

cards.title: Confirm exact package name from official registry
cards.when: Use this card before adding a package whose name came from memory or a search result.
cards.cmds:
npm view left-pad name
npm view left-pad repository.url

cards.title: Inspect install scripts before installing a package
cards.when: Use this card when a package will run npm lifecycle scripts during installation.
cards.cmds:
npm view left-pad scripts
npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts left-pad
npm audit

cards.title: Measure lockfile size before approving a dependency
cards.when: Use this card after a candidate package is added to the lockfile to estimate its weight.
cards.cmds:
wc -c package-lock.json
npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts left-pad
wc -c package-lock.json

cards.title: Review migration UI parity for one feature
cards.when: Use when a Python migration changes a CLI, web UI, or API surface for the same migration verb.
cards.cmds:
rg -n migrations app/
git diff --unified=5 main
python3 -m pytest tests/test_migration_ui.py -q
rg -n migration_status app/

cards.title: Verify migration safety checks are shared
cards.when: Use when a Python migration adds a destructive operation and the UI must show the same confirmation.
cards.cmds:
rg -n confirm_migration app/
rg -n confirm_migration web/
python3 -m pytest tests/test_migration_confirm.py -q
git diff --unified=3 main -- app/

cards.title: Review migration output parity across surfaces
cards.when: Use when a Python migration changes output keys, exit codes, or words shown to users in multiple surfaces.
cards.cmds:
rg -n migration_key app/migrations/
rg -n migration_key web/
python3 -m pytest tests/test_migration_output.py -q
git diff --name-only main

cards.title: Review migration UI change lands in one diff
cards.when: Use when a Python migration feature should appear in CLI, UI, and API in the same review.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only main
rg -n add_migration app/
rg -n migrations web/routes/
python3 -m pytest tests/migrations -q

cards.title: Verify Tailwind build output includes expected utilities
cards.when: When reviewing CSS changes to ensure the generated stylesheet contains the new classes.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
grep "\.bg-blue-500" /tmp/out.css
stat -c %s /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Check class ordering with Prettier plugin
cards.when: When reviewing HTML or JSX files for consistent Tailwind class order.
cards.cmds:
npx prettier --check src/components/Button.tsx
npx prettier src/components/Button.tsx | diff src/components/Button.tsx -
cat package.json | grep prettier-plugin-tailwindcss

cards.title: Review type design for CSS-in-JS schemas
cards.when: When a change introduces new TypeScript interfaces for styling configurations.
cards.cmds:
rg "interface.*Style" src
cat src/types/Theme.ts
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Run SQL migration with error stopping
cards.when: When you need to execute a schema migration file against a scratch database safely.
cards.cmds:
test -f migration.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo $?

cards.title: Verify CSS build output and syntax
cards.when: Use when checking if a stylesheet compiles correctly.
cards.cmds:
find ./src -name "*.css" -type f
npx prettier --check ./src/styles/main.css
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify

cards.title: Check HTML structure with linting
cards.when: Use when verifying HTML files are well-formed.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.html" -type f
npx eslint --no-eslintrc --parser-options=ecmaVersion:2022 ./index.html
wc -l ./index.html

cards.title: Validate class name usage in HTML
cards.when: Use when ensuring HTML uses defined CSS classes.
cards.cmds:
grep -o "class=\"[^\"]*\"" ./index.html
grep -o "\.[a-z-]*" ./src/styles/main.css
ls ./index.html ./src/styles/main.css

cards.title: Validate user input with Pydantic schemas
cards.when: Adding new API endpoints or parsing external data to ensure strict type safety and validation.
cards.cmds:
touch models.py
python -m pytest tests/test_validation.py -v
python -m pytest -q
python -m pytest tests/test_validation.py::test_invalid_input -v

cards.title: Sanitize HTML output to prevent XSS
cards.when: Rendering user-provided content in a web application template or API response.
cards.cmds:
pip install bleach
touch tests/test_xss.py
touch tests/test_xss.py
python -m pytest tests/test_xss.py::test_strip_script -v

cards.title: Check dependency vulnerabilities with pip
cards.when: Before deploying a Python application, ensuring installed libraries do not have known security flaws.
cards.cmds:
pip install pip-audit
python -m pip_audit
echo $?
pip install --upgrade requests

cards.title: Locate missing file exports in JS
cards.when: When node reports a module not found or undefined variable in ES modules
cards.cmds:
pwd
find . -name '*.js'
rg 'export.*name' src
cat src/utils.js
rg 'from.*utils' app.js

cards.title: Fix ESLint no-unused-vars errors
cards.when: When eslint reports unused variables or functions in JavaScript files
cards.cmds:
npx eslint . --format=unix
sed -n '42,42p' src/index.js
npx eslint src/index.js

cards.title: Resolve npm dependency version conflicts
cards.when: When npm install fails due to version conflicts in package.json
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
grep '"version"' package-lock.json | head -5
npm install
ls node_modules

cards.title: Compile C file with strict warnings as errors
cards.when: A single C source file needs to be validated for syntax and style errors before building.
cards.cmds:
cd /src/c_project
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/main.c -o /dev/null
echo $?

cards.title: Run project test suite via make target
cards.when: The C project uses Makefile for building and running its automated test harness.
cards.cmds:
cd /src/c_project
make test
echo $?

cards.title: Build C test binary with Address Sanitizer
cards.when: A test binary needs to be compiled with memory safety checks to detect leaks and overflows.
cards.cmds:
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -c src/test_main.c -o test_obj.o
cc -fsanitize=address,undefined test_obj.o -o test_bin
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Check for memory leaks using Valgrind
cards.when: Sanitizers are unavailable or you need detailed leak reports for a compiled C test binary.
cards.cmds:
test -x ./test_bin
which valgrind
cat valgrind.log

cards.title: Verify Fast-Forward Capability Before Pushing to Main
cards.when: When preparing to push a release branch to main to ensure no force push is required.
cards.cmds:
git fetch origin main
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Validate File Equality Between Branch and Scratch Worktree
cards.when: When ensuring the scratch worktree contains exactly the intended changes before shipping.
cards.cmds:
git worktree add /tmp/scratch origin/main
cp src/app.py /tmp/scratch/src/app.py
diff /tmp/scratch/src/app.py src/app.py
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Execute Release Test Suite on Oldest Supported Python
cards.when: When validating code changes before merging to main to catch legacy runtime errors.
cards.cmds:
grep -A 5 "python-version" .github/workflows/test.yml
python3 -m pytest
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Monitor CI Pipeline for Pushed Release Commit
cards.when: When waiting for continuous integration results after pushing a release commit to main.
cards.cmds:
sampo ci-watch --commit abc123
tail -n 5 /dev/null
sampo ci-watch --commit abc123

cards.title: Verify Rust release build and lint status

cargo fmt --check
cargo test

echo "// add traceparent injection code"
cargo clippy --all-targets

cards.title: Bound metric labels to prevent cardinality explosion

echo "define label allowlist in code"
cargo test --lib
cargo run --release

cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

cargo check
cargo audit

git diff
cargo test snapshot -- --nocapture

grep -r "aria-label" src/ui
cargo test accessibility
cat test-output.log

cards.title: Check for forbidden soft language words
cards.when: Documentation must use plain words without filler terms.

grep -niwE 'just' docs/task.md
grep -niwE 'obviously' docs/task.md

cards.title: Validate step structure in documentation
cards.when: Each step must have a verb start and observable result.

head -1 docs/task.md | cut -d ' ' -f1
tail -1 docs/task.md

cards.title: Capture pytest suite output to log file
cards.when: You need to save the full test suite results to a file for later inspection.

mkdir -p logs
python -m pytest -q
ls -l logs

cards.title: Extract failed test names from pytest output
cards.when: You have a pytest log file and need to list only the tests that failed.

grep 'FAILED' logs/pytest.log
awk '{print $2}' logs/pytest.log
sort -u

cards.title: Count total and passed tests from pytest log
cards.when: You need a quick summary of how many tests were run and how many passed.
cards.cmds:
grep 'passed' logs/pytest.log
awk '{print $1}'
grep 'failed' logs/pytest.log

cards.title: Capture environment details for reproducibility
cards.when: You want to record the Python version and installed packages for the test run.
cards.cmds:
python --version
pip freeze
pwd

cards.title: Verify Ruby gem dependencies are installed
cards.when: Before running tests or linting to ensure the environment matches the lock file.

cd /app
bundle check
ruby -v

cards.title: Run RSpec suite with locked gems
cards.when: When verifying that all Ruby test cases pass using the project's specific gem versions.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rspec
find spec -name "*_spec.rb" | wc -l
echo $?

cards.title: Check Ruby syntax with warnings enabled
cards.when: When validating that a specific Ruby file has no syntax errors before execution.

test -f lib/parser.rb
ruby -wc lib/parser.rb
echo $?

bundle exec rubocop --format json | jq '.total_offenses'

cards.title: Review Rust ownership and borrow patterns
cards.when: When checking if Rust code uses references correctly and avoids unnecessary cloning.

find . -name '*.rs'
rg 'fn.*\&Vec<' *.rs
cargo check
grep -n 'clone' src/main.rs

cards.title: Validate Rust error handling with thiserror

rg '#\[derive\(thiserror::Error\)\]' *.rs
cargo test
grep -r 'anyhow' src/lib.rs

cards.title: Verify Rust concurrency with Arc and Mutex
cards.when: When checking if shared state in Rust uses `Arc<Mutex<T>>` for thread safety.
cards.cmds:
rg 'Arc<' src
rg 'Mutex<' src
cargo clippy
rg 'Rc<' src

cards.title: Enforce minimal public API surface in Rust
cards.when: When ensuring that a Rust crate exposes only necessary public items.

rg 'pub fn' src/lib.rs
rg 'pub ' src
cargo doc --no-deps
rg 'pub mod' src/lib.rs

cards.title: Verify Tailwind build output with npx
cards.when: You need to confirm the CSS bundle generates correctly before deploying.

cd .
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
ls -la /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Test Tailwind class ordering with Prettier
cards.when: You are ensuring that utility classes follow the enforced style guide.

npx prettier --check .
npx prettier --write .

cards.when: You need to assert that components behave correctly at specific viewports.

ls playwright-report
cat playwright-report/index.html | head -20

psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo $?

npx eslint .
npm ci

cards.title: Diagnose Rust compilation errors with detailed output
cards.when: Use when cargo check or build fails and you need to understand the specific error cause.
cards.cmds:
cargo check
cargo check -v
cargo clippy

cards.title: Verify Tailwind CLI build succeeds
cards.when: When you need to confirm the CSS build pipeline works correctly
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
test -s /tmp/out.css
stat -c %s /tmp/out.css
grep -c error /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Check class ordering with Prettier
cards.when: When you need to verify Tailwind class ordering is consistent
cards.cmds:
npx prettier --check .
echo $?
npx prettier --list-different .
find . -name '*.html' -o -name '*.tsx' | wc -l

cards.title: Test responsive breakpoint behavior
cards.when: When you need to verify components collapse correctly at mobile widths
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx playwright test tests/nav.spec.ts
grep -c failed node_modules/.cache/playwright/results.txt
cat node_modules/.cache/playwright/results.txt | head -20

cards.title: Measure context cost of CLAUDE.md and rules
cards.when: You need to verify if instruction files exceed budget limits or identify expensive imports.
cards.cmds:
wc -l CLAUDE.md .claude/rules/*.md
grep -n '^@' CLAUDE.md

cards.title: Verify JavaScript syntax and linting before capture
cards.when: You must ensure JS files parse correctly and pass linting rules.
cards.cmds:
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .
